impact.source: Grun et al. 1985 (ESA MADWEB form); cross-check Brown et al. 2002 N(>D)=37 D^-2.7 per yr on Earth

Earth-Moon L4/L5 (searched).note: Kordylewski-cloud sims: <0.1% of stable paths remain after 100 yr (Celest Mech Dyn Astr 2024)

Moon surface.note: no dynamical removal; burial by regolith gardening (Speyerer+2016) not modelled

Sun-Earth L4/L5, most stable region.note: MEGASIM: stretched-exponential decay, none left by 2.33 Gyr (ApJ 2022); 1e9 yr used as order of magnitude

Mars Trojans.note: dynamical half-lives ~ age of Solar System (Scholl+2005)

Main belt (1 m body).note: Yarkovsky removal ~0.03%/Myr; collisional lifetime 14 Myr used for impacts (Bottke+2005)

Jupiter Trojans.note: ~23-25% escape over Solar System age (MNRAS 2020, Jovian Trojan stability) -> e-folding ~17 Gyr
